# Víctor Redondo

> Design, apps and other projects by Víctor Redondo Vargas (Spain).

## Apps
- [Loop](https://vredondo.com/loop/en/): Apple Watch and iPhone app that connects Bluetooth treadmills and walking pads (FTMS or RSC) to Apple Fitness and Apple Health with the distance, speed and steps the treadmill measures. One-time purchase, no subscription, 4-day free trial. Details: https://vredondo.com/loop/llms.txt

## Site
- [Contact](https://vredondo.com/contacto/): contact form for projects, collaborations or ideas (opens the visitor's email app; nothing is sent to a server).
- [Privacy](https://vredondo.com/privacidad/): privacy policy for vredondo.com (no cookies, no analytics, no third-party content).
